Re: Pre-service appeal of denial for total hip replacement  
Member: Skyler Foster  
Member ID: W944120051  
Procedure: Total hip replacement, CPT 27130  
Reference number: POC-DA7FAA7DB4-93242  
Date of denial notice: August 13, 2026  

Dear CommunityCare Appeals Department:

I am appealing CommunityCare’s denial of prior authorization for total hip replacement, CPT 27130. The denial states that the submitted imaging findings do not support medical necessity. The imaging and the complete clinical record support the requested procedure.

The June 8, 2026 weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph documented severe structural abnormalities in the affected hip: superolateral joint-space narrowing to 1 mm, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophyte formation. These findings are consistent with advanced degenerative joint disease and provide objective radiographic evidence of substantial joint deterioration.

The imaging findings also correspond directly to the patient’s symptoms, examination findings, functional limitations, and unsuccessful conservative treatment:

- Progressive hip pain has continued for nine months and is not relieved by rest.
- The patient completed 16 weeks and 16 visits of supervised physical therapy from March 11, 2026, through July 1, 2026, focused on hip-abductor strengthening and gait.
- NSAID treatment for four months provided inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 19, 2026, produced only three weeks of partial relief.
- The patient ambulates with a cane and is limited to approximately one block.
- The patient cannot put on shoes without assistance.
- Provocative testing is positive on the affected side.
- Hip range of motion is limited by pain.

The requested arthroplasty is therefore supported not only by the radiograph but also by persistent symptoms, objective examination findings, major functional impairment, and failure of extended conservative management.

The patient has no active infection, no untreated substance-use condition, a BMI of 29, and is a nonsmoker. These records do not identify a clinical contraindication to the requested surgery.

I request that CommunityCare reverse the denial and authorize CPT 27130. Please have the request reviewed by an orthopedic physician or other qualified physician who was not involved in the initial denial.

The denial notice refers generally to an applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria, but no CPT 27130-specific policy, policy number, effective date, or imaging criteria were provided in the materials available to me. I have not quoted a plan policy because I was unable to locate a publicly available CommunityCare policy containing the medical-necessity criteria for this procedure. If CommunityCare continues to deny the request, please provide the exact policy and clinical review criteria applied to this case, including the policy title, policy number, version or effective date, the specific imaging requirements, and the clinical rationale for determining that the June 8, 2026 radiograph did not satisfy those requirements.

Please include the complete clinical-review rationale and all records relied upon in the appeal determination.

This appeal is submitted within the 180-day appeal period stated in the denial notice and must be received no later than February 9, 2027.

Sincerely,

Skyler Foster
